name: AWS EC2 — Instances
description: Pull EC2 instances as cloud workloads from AWS for CNAPP inventory and posture analysis

steps.instruction: Log into the AWS Management Console and go to IAM → Users
Create a new user (or select an existing one) and attach the AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess managed policy
Go to Security credentials → Create access key → Choose 'Third-party service'
Specify the AWS region to scan

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to AWS EC2. Verify your access key has AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess permission and the region is correct.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'instance_id': str(record.get('instanceId', '')), 'arn': 'arn:aws:ec2::' + str(record.get('instanceId', '')), 'region': (str(record.get('placement', {}).get('availabilityZone', ''))[:-1] if record.get('placement', {}).get('availabilityZone') else ''), 'availability_zone': record.get('placement', {}).get('availabilityZone', ''), 'display_name': record.get('instanceId', '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'resource_type': 'ec2_instance', 'instance_type': record.get('instanceType', ''), 'state': record.get('instanceState', {}).get('name', ''), 'vpc_id': record.get('vpcId', ''), 'subnet_id': record.get('subnetId', ''), 'availability_zone': record.get('placement', {}).get('availabilityZone', ''), 'image_id': record.get('imageId', ''), 'platform': record.get('platform', 'linux'), 'private_ip_address': record.get('privateIpAddress', ''), 'public_ip_address': record.get('ipAddress', ''), 'iam_instance_profile_arn': (record.get('iamInstanceProfile', {}) or {}).get('arn', ''), 'security_groups': [g.get('groupId', '') for g in (((record.get('groupSet') or {}).get('item') or []))], 'tags': {t.get('key', ''): t.get('value', '') for t in (((record.get('tagSet') or {}).get('item') or []))}}

region.description: AWS region to scan for EC2 instances (e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1)
